title: Purple Dye
summary: Single-use purple dye for compatible equipment.

fields.Apply: Combine with one item of equipment to change its colours. Results depend on the item’s materials. Dye Remover restores the original palette.
fields.Acquisition: Traders including Arron, Quartermaster Talli, and Roberon Silt.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
